services.title: Our Services
services.intro: We provide full-cycle construction project services: from architectural concept to commissioning and completion of all legal formalities.

items.title: Design
items.subtitle: Projekteerimine
items.description: Complete design support in accordance with Estonian building regulations.
bullets: Architectural and structural design: sketch (eskiis), preliminary (eelprojekt), main (põhiprojekt) and working project (tööprojekt)
Preparation and approval of documentation for building permits (ehitusluba)
Structural solutions: load-bearing structure calculations and detailing

items.title: Engineering Systems
items.subtitle: Eriosad ja tehnosüsteemid
items.description: Design and integration of engineering systems with a focus on energy efficiency.
bullets: HVAC: heating, ventilation and air conditioning
Electrical supply: power and low-voltage networks, building automation
Water supply and sewage: internal and external networks

items.title: Construction & General Contracting
items.subtitle: Ehitus ja peatöövõtt
items.description: Comprehensive construction management and turnkey execution.
bullets: General contracting: subcontractor coordination, timelines and budget
Design supervision (autorijärelevalve): ensuring works match the design

items.title: Commissioning
items.subtitle: Kasutusloa taotlemine
items.description: Project completion and handover of the building.

about.title: ABOUT US
about.p1: We believe construction should be a predictable and comfortable process. That is why we work on a single-window principle — we take on full project management from the initial idea to completion.

items.label: Design:
items.text: we create the architectural concept and precise engineering calculations.

items.label: Permits:
items.text: we obtain building permits and handle all authorities ourselves.

items.label: Construction:
items.text: we build the project, strictly controlling quality, timelines and budget.

items.label: Commissioning:
items.text: we prepare final documents and hand you the keys.

about.p3: Your benefit — no stress. You do not need to find different contractors, coordinate them, or bear risks at stage transitions. One company is responsible for everything. You make only key decisions; we handle all the routine.
about.p4: we manage the project from the first drawing to the finished building.
